Backup → encrypt → decrypt → overwrite restore → row-count + SHA dual verification → review match; the whole chain runs automatically once.
What gets written is the current data you just exported (reversible and lossless); no passphrase needed, nothing is written to disk, and the result is logged as DRILL.
Neither the WebDAV provider nor anyone who gets the file can read the plaintext. Forgetting the passphrase means the backup cannot be restored, so keep it safe.
A backup file = a snapshot of all 25 tables in the database plus a per-table SHA-256 manifest, encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase.

Clears all data first, then rebuilds from the backup—truly returning to the point in time of the backup. Any data added after that point is lost (an accidental restore can be recovered from the pre-restore snapshot).
Only overwrites the tables included in the backup; everything else stays as it is. Useful when you want to merge part of an old backup back in.
Then it overwrites the main database and runs row-count + SHA-256 dual verification.

Xiaomi systems do not allow apps to show content on the lock screen or to pop up from the background by default, so "Strong reminder (full screen)" and "Lock screen emergency info" still need to be allowed manually in the system — Permissions → Other permissions → turn on: %1$s (turning on autostart is also recommended, as it is needed to reschedule reminders after a restart).

If notifications do not show a banner or do not appear on the lock screen: go to "Settings → Apps → ASHKB → Notification management" and for each channel ① turn on "Floating notifications" (banners) ② set "On lock screen" to "Show notifications and content" (lock screen) — Xiaomi does not grant these two to third-party apps by default; in testing, banners and lock screen both recovered after turning them on (confirmed by the user on 2026-09-27). These two switches are saved by the system and the app cannot set them for you.

Xiaomi also has a "notification filtering" tier that folds some apps' notifications into "Unimportant notifications". This is also decided by the system, and the app can neither request nor query it, so no status is shown here.

Xiaomi / HyperOS: whether this card shows a banner and can appear on the lock screen is decided by two switches on the \"Settings → Apps → ASHKB → Notification management → Lock screen emergency info\" page, and neither is granted to third-party apps by default — ① turn on \"Floating notifications\" (banners); ② set \"On lock screen\" to \"Show notifications and content\" (lock screen). In testing, banners and lock screen returned to normal once both were turned on. It is also recommended to turn on \"Lock screen display\" under \"Permissions → Other permissions\". During an infection with fever, immunosuppressants may need to be paused — contact your doctor first to confirm whether to stop and when to resume.
Some medicines (especially biologics / immunosuppressants) must be stopped before surgery with a defined washout window — confirm the timing with your doctor.
If cost is the reason for stopping, discuss alternatives with your doctor — do not interrupt treatment on your own.
